CREATE TABLE job_projection_state (
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	deleted_at TEXT, 
	print_job_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	observed_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completed_layers INTEGER, 
	first_terminal_receipt_id TEXT, 
	first_terminal_state TEXT, 
	terminal_seen_at TEXT, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_job_projection_state PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_revision_valid CHECK (typeof(revision) = 'integer' AND revision >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_times_valid CHECK (length(created_at) = 27 AND length(updated_at) = 27), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_time_order CHECK (updated_at >= created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_deletion_time CHECK (deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= created_at), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_observed_state_enum CHECK (observed_state IN ('started','running','paused','completed','failed','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_observed_at_format CHECK (length(observed_at) = 27), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_source_sequence_range CHECK (typeof(source_sequence) = 'integer' AND source_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_completed_layers_range CHECK (completed_layers IS NULL OR (typeof(completed_layers) = 'integer' AND completed_layers BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_terminal_state_enum CHECK (first_terminal_state IS NULL OR first_terminal_state IN ('completed','failed','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_projection_state_terminal_shape CHECK ((first_terminal_receipt_id IS NULL AND first_terminal_state IS NULL AND terminal_seen_at IS NULL AND observed_state IN ('started','running','paused')) OR (first_terminal_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND first_terminal_state IS NOT NULL AND terminal_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND length(terminal_seen_at) = 27 AND first_terminal_state = observed_state AND terminal_seen_at = observed_at)), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_job_projection_state_device_id_device_identity FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES device_identity (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_job_projection_state_print_job_id_print_job FOREIGN KEY(print_job_id) REFERENCES print_job (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_job_projection_state_last_receipt_id_external_event_receipt FOREIGN KEY(last_receipt_id) REFERENCES external_event_receipt (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_job_projection_state_first_terminal_receipt_id_external_event_receipt FOREIGN KEY(first_terminal_receipt_id) REFERENCES external_event_receipt (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE job_receipt_application (
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	device_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TEXT NOT NULL, 
	receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	print_job_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	contract_version TEXT NOT NULL, 
	outcome TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reason_code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	request_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_job_receipt_application PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_receipt_application_created_at_format CHECK (length(created_at) = 27), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_receipt_application_contract_version CHECK (contract_version = 'job-receipt-projection-v1'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_receipt_application_outcome_enum CHECK (outcome IN ('APPLIED','IGNORED_STALE','CONFLICT')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_receipt_application_reason_code_length CHECK (length(reason_code) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_job_receipt_application_request_hash_format CHECK (length(request_hash) = 64 AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_job_receipt_application_device_id_device_identity FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES device_identity (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_job_receipt_application_receipt_id_external_event_receipt FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES external_event_receipt (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_job_receipt_application_print_job_id_print_job FOREIGN KEY(print_job_id) REFERENCES print_job (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_job_projection_state_print_job_id ON job_projection_state (print_job_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_job_receipt_application_receipt_id ON job_receipt_application (receipt_id)
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_receipt_application_update BEFORE UPDATE ON job_receipt_application WHEN 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'history.immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_receipt_application_delete BEFORE DELETE ON job_receipt_application WHEN 1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'history.immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_projection_state_terminal_facts BEFORE UPDATE ON job_projection_state WHEN OLD.first_terminal_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.last_receipt_id IS NOT OLD.last_receipt_id OR NEW.observed_state IS NOT OLD.observed_state OR NEW.observed_at IS NOT OLD.observed_at OR NEW.source_sequence IS NOT OLD.source_sequence OR NEW.completed_layers IS NOT OLD.completed_layers OR NEW.first_terminal_receipt_id IS NOT OLD.first_terminal_receipt_id OR NEW.first_terminal_state IS NOT OLD.first_terminal_state OR NEW.terminal_seen_at IS NOT OLD.terminal_seen_at) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'job_projection.terminal_facts_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_receipt_application_scope_insert BEFORE INSERT ON job_receipt_application WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_event_receipt r JOIN print_job j ON j.printer_id=r.printer_id WHERE r.id=NEW.receipt_id AND j.id=NEW.print_job_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'job_projection.receipt_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_receipt_application_scope_update BEFORE UPDATE ON job_receipt_application WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_event_receipt r JOIN print_job j ON j.printer_id=r.printer_id WHERE r.id=NEW.receipt_id AND j.id=NEW.print_job_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'job_projection.receipt_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_projection_state_scope_insert BEFORE INSERT ON job_projection_state WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_event_receipt r JOIN print_job j ON j.printer_id=r.printer_id WHERE r.id=NEW.last_receipt_id AND j.id=NEW.print_job_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'job_projection.receipt_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_projection_state_scope_update BEFORE UPDATE ON job_projection_state WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_event_receipt r JOIN print_job j ON j.printer_id=r.printer_id WHERE r.id=NEW.last_receipt_id AND j.id=NEW.print_job_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'job_projection.receipt_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_projection_state_terminal_scope_insert BEFORE INSERT ON job_projection_state WHEN NEW.first_terminal_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_event_receipt r JOIN print_job j ON j.printer_id=r.printer_id WHERE r.id=NEW.first_terminal_receipt_id AND j.id=NEW.print_job_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'job_projection.receipt_scope_conflict'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS guard_job_projection_state_terminal_scope_update BEFORE UPDATE ON job_projection_state WHEN NEW.first_terminal_receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_event_receipt r JOIN print_job j ON j.printer_id=r.printer_id WHERE r.id=NEW.first_terminal_receipt_id AND j.id=NEW.print_job_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'job_projection.receipt_scope_conflict'); END
